invariants.rationale: The config parameter is expected to be non-null for configuration to be used in the method.
The context parameter must be non-null for engine context methods to be invoked.
The base path is accessed inside the method, indicating it must not be null.
The consistency guard config is accessed in building the meta client, so it should be non-null.
Time generator config is passed to the meta client builder, thus should not be null.
